profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer | React, Typescript, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Node, Express.js, Python
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building and scaling production-grade web applications and cloud-based systems. Strong background in full-stack development, AI-powered and LLM-integrated applications, and cloud infrastructure on AWS. Proven ability to design RESTful APIs, optimize performance, and deliver reliable systems in Agile environments for U.S. and international clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full Stack Software Developer for Sparkfire AI.
• Designed, developed, and maintained scalable web applications using Next.js, React, and TypeScript
• Built and integrated RESTful APIs using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL
• Development and integration of LLM-powered and conversational AI features, implementing RAG workflows, embedding, text classification, and context retrieval.
• Deployed and maintained AWS cloud infrastructure, leveraging compute, storage, and serverless services to support scalable workloads.
• Designed and supported CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated testing and deployments and reducing release risk.
• Developed and deployed an AI-powered Chatbot using React, TypeScript, enabling conversational interactions.
• Applied best practices for clean architecture, security, and performance, contributing to long-term platform maintainability.

Technical Consultant and Software Developer for Servicenow Platform products.

• Collaborated with team members to achieve project goals and support the growth of services delivered by the company.
